target: Tangent Finance USG harvest class (RewardAccumulator.processRewards permissionless harvester fee) on ethereum - lead-stage EV
notes: Scouted the last open non-liquidation protocol on the farm chains. processRewards is permissionless and pays the caller-chosen receiver, but the whole 30 d harvester pool measured 70 USD (223.95 CRV at 0.2626 USD + token dust) while the incumbent harvests each market every ~3 h paying 1.5-7 USD gas per harvest - our after-gas EV with the incumbent present is not clearly positive, so closed dead_end at the lead stage per the aave2-dust template. Also recorded the relay pitfall: eth_call without a from field reverts with empty data (2026-11-08, measured against a known-active ERC20).
